fit_report.json.definition: Response=(selected mean g1 plus - selected mean g1 minus)/.04. Horvitz-Thompson weighted sampled union. Differences are on the same sampled IDs and original pixels.
fit_report.json.limitations: Four cases; two seeded repetitions plus original entropy-seeded fit. Fitter-noise projection uses first-order ratio influence and independent per-object optimizer streams; it excludes image noise, flow integration, scene variance and systematics. Sample change SE conditions on the fitted catalogues; paired case bootstrap describes only these four scenes.

fit_parameters_report.json.sample: Uniform512 IDs from case1000 union selection, both legs; results conditional on per-leg cuts and both fits usable/successful. Same ID may appear in both legs.

selected_stress_examples.selection: 16 largest changes among the 1021-case/leg seeded-replay sample; deliberately selected stress examples, not a population estimate

fit_parameters_report.json.interpretation: Negative T is explicitly permitted by original prior. This identifies large optimizer scatter, not a proof of mean calibration bias; no positivity cut or changed fitter was applied. The original success flag and disk-ellipticity usability do not exclude these solutions.
